summary: Pharvaris N.V. filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026, reporting its first-quarter 2026 financial results and business updates. The press release discloses cash and cash equivalents of $247 million as of March 31, 2026, and notes a subsequent $132 million underwritten offering extending cash runway into 2028. Clinical milestones include expected topline data from the CHAPTER-3 Phase 3 study of deucrictibant XR for HAE prophylaxis in Q3 2026 and an NDA submission for deucrictibant IR for on-demand treatment in H1 2026. This is a routine earnings report with no special-situation transaction.
